title: Design System: DSH Render Engine Local Preview

title.purpose: Names the local preview in its header.

body.purpose: Inherited baseline for the compact overlay.

code.purpose: Editable source, highlighted code, structured tokens, and escaped HTML.

label.purpose: Field labels, pipeline metadata, subtitle, and status.

shadows.name: overlay-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the expanded fixed overlay from the DSH host.

components.name: Overlay Shell
components.description: The private fixed integration surface that contains the complete debugging workflow.
components.css: .ds-overlay-shell { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; width: min(460px, calc(100vw - 32px)); min-height: 300px; overflow: hidden; color: #0f1115; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dedfe2; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(15 23 42 / 18%); font: 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-overlay-shell header { padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dedfe2; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-overlay-shell main { padding: 16px; background: #f7f8fa; }

components.name: Collapse Control
components.description: A compact chevron button that collapses the overlay while preserving host access.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="收起预览"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m8 10 4 4 4-4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; color: #0f1115; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #465bdb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Pipeline Strip
components.description: A non-interactive legend for the Shiki to Tokens to HTML rendering path.
components.css: .ds-pipeline { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 16px; color: #68707d; background: #f7f8fa; border-bottom: 1px solid #dedfe2; font: 11px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-pipeline b { color: #0f1115; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; } .ds-pipeline i { width: 12px; height: 1px; background: #dedfe2; }

components.name: Language Select
components.description: The labeled language selector used to drive both public rendering services.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #68707d; font: 11px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field select { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 30px 0 10px; color: #0f1115; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dedfe2; border-radius: 9px; font: 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #465bdb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Editor
components.description: A compact fixed-width editor for changing the integration probe source.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-source-editor" aria-label="示例代码" spellcheck="false">const result = render(code)</textarea>
components.css: .ds-source-editor { width: 100%; min-height: 128px; resize: none; padding: 12px; color: #0f1115; caret-color: #465bdb; background: #f7f8fa; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; outline: none; font: 12px/1.55 "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; tab-size: 2; } .ds-source-editor:focus { outline: 2px solid #465bdb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Output Tabs
components.description: The accessible three-representation switcher for Preview, Tokens, and HTML.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dedfe2; } .ds-tab { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; color: #68707d; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 12px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #0f1115; background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #465bdb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: #465bdb; background: #eef0ff; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Structured Output Pane
components.description: A scrollable fixed-width pane for token JSON or escaped rendered HTML.
components.css: .ds-data-pane { min-height: 160px; margin: 0; padding: 14px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; color: #0f1115; background: #f7f8fa; border: 1px solid #dedfe2; border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px; font: 11px/1.55 "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-data-pane::selection { color: #fff; background: #465bdb; }

components.name: Collapsed Launcher
components.description: The persistent control that reopens the local preview after collapse.
components.css: .ds-launcher { min-width: 112px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; color: #fff; background: #465bdb; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(70 91 219 / 28%); font: 650 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-launcher:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #465bdb; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This visual contract belongs only to the private `integration/consumer` preview. Its FORM is `local-extension/no-roll`: a deliberately scoped extension that borrows the established DSH light system UI so it feels native inside the host, without creating or implying a broader repository design system.

The overlay makes the Shiki → Tokens → HTML mechanism directly inspectable. It stays visually quiet and operational: one bordered right-side tool surface, compact system typography, monospace only for code and structured data, and an indigo accent reserved for interaction and focus. Its visual hierarchy supports the public `syntaxHighlighter` and `codeRenderer` service boundary; it does not turn DSH into a dashboard or add UI to published packages.
keyCharacteristics: Matched to DSH's restrained light system interface.
One compact overlay with code-first density.
Public service output is inspectable in Preview, Tokens, and HTML representations.
Collapsible so the host interface remains usable.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Instrument Indigo is the only interactive accent; do not introduce competing action colors.

rules.name: The Host-Light Rule
rules.body: This overlay always declares a light color scheme and remains visually compatible with the established DSH light UI.

rules.name: The Monospace Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only where the user is reading or editing code, tokens, or HTML; all surrounding interface copy stays in the system sans serif.

rules.name: The Host-Presence Rule
rules.body: The preview may cover the host while open, but it must always collapse to a small lower-right launcher.

rules.name: The Two-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Use ambient shadow only for the fixed overlay and its collapsed launcher; internal panes stay flat and bordered.

dos: Do keep this design contract scoped to `integration/consumer` and FORM `local-extension/no-roll`.
Do match the established DSH light UI through system typography, cool neutrals, compact density, and restrained rounding.
Do expose results from the public `syntaxHighlighter` and `codeRenderer` services without duplicating their rendering logic.
Do preserve keyboard focus, labeled controls, ARIA tabs, and collapse/reopen behavior.
Do preserve host usability at desktop and mobile viewport sizes.
donts: Don't treat this file as a design system for the repository, published packages, or DSH as a whole.
Don't add dashboard chrome, marketing styling, or a second accent hierarchy.
Don't move preview UI or preview-only tokens into any published package.
Don't use monospace for general interface copy.
Don't let internal cards or panes compete with the overlay shell through extra shadow.
